avis.titre: This Product Is Affordable And It Works!
avis.texte: This is an amazing product. I am very acne prone and I am black so my skin does get dark acne scars. This product change my life it really does give you the same eefects of getting a chemical peel with out as much down time and you can do it more frequently which allows you to see results faster. PLEASE READ INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE USE. I saw one of the lower rated reviews and the reviewer mentioned that after the peel she went on to do her skincare routine and over time her skin barrier was ruined. THE INSTRUCTIONS CLEARLY SAY DO NOT APPLY ANY PRODUCT AFTER USE! The most I have apply is the after use is the tower 28 recovery cream if my skin is feeling a little sensitive or raw afterwards. PLEASE DO NOT APPLY ANY SKINCARE AFTER, ESPECIALLY NOT YOUR FULL ROUTINE.

I have been using this product for about two weeks twice a week and I noticed an extreme difference in my skin tone is so nice now that it's even and the dark marks are leaving. Your face. Definitely does feel a little bit airy. It's like when you eat gum and drink water, but it's nothing unbearable.
I have used this twice and when i tell you it has CHANGED my skin I mean it. I have never had smoother, more even, and just radiant skin. It has been a GAME CHANGER for my skin

avis.titre: Great Dupe for The Ordinary BHA Peel
avis.texte: This is a great dupe for The Ordinary Chemical BHA Peel! The smell is a little strong and it's a beautiful teal color. It took me 3 1/2 weeks to see results, because I was using while I had sensitive/raw areas. But, if I would have healed my face then it would have given me a faster result. Make sure you have a high quality sunscreen to use after each use so you can see results. 8/10 recommend!!

Been struggling with acne around my jaw/chin, texture/closed comedones, and sensitivity. And this peel has been amazing. Every exfoliant damages my skin but this is so gentle & effective. Alternating with Cerave retinol *chefs kiss*
This stuff is amazing. Even after just 1 use my skin felt softer and glowed! My skin looks brighter and I will definitely repurchase this. Also the color is beautiful
This stuff is amazing. Even after just 1 use my skin felt softer and glowed! My skin looks brighter and I will definitely repurchase this. Also the color is beautiful

I tried this hoping to help all the dark spots from acne. I am 45 yo and feel like my skin is problem skin. I didnt leave it on the whole 15 mins bc it did burn but i am shocked at how much brighter my skin looked! It really faded my dark spots. My husband even noticed!!
My skin feels so smooth after, I did notice the texture is less bumpy. Highly recommend a very good moisturizer after you put dry. Love this product!!
I got this for christmas and have really oily skin, after I spot tested it on my cheeks, it left that spot soooo clean! Like it sucked the oil out!

Years ago I loved a peel that Neutrogena had - they discontinued it and I had never found anything with similar results until now. I have dry, sensitive, aging skin and this product is incredibly gentle, yet effective. My skin looks much clearer, brighter and it makes my moisturizing products so much more effective. I'm buying a backup bottle now - please don't ever discontinue this. PS - It does smell bad when you put it on, but it is short lived, and completely worth it.

avis.titre: Instant Brightness and Smoother Skin – A Gentle Yet Effectiv
avis.texte: I've been using the L'Oreal Paris Bright Reveal Exfoliant Peel for a few weeks now, and the results are impressive! The texture of my skin feels smoother, and the overall tone has visibly brightened. The peel isn't harsh, which I appreciate for my sensitive skin, yet it effectively exfoliates, removing dead skin cells and leaving my face feeling refreshed. I noticed fewer dark spots, and my skin feels more radiant, especially when used as part of my nighttime routine. The packaging is sleek and user-friendly, and the formula is gentle but effective. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a brighter, more even complexion

This stuff works yall!! It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth while looking flawless. Pores are almost non existent after 4-6 weeks. Also doesn't irritate my sensitive skin!! I received this product in exchange for my honest review but will definitely be purchasing this soon once I am out

avis.titre: Feels like I rubbed Vicks on my face
avis.texte: After applying this to my face I have been to look at the ingredients on the package. There are two different dyes in this product. Not really sure why those are necessary as those will definitely soak your bloodstream through your skin. Also noticed that there is some sort of menthol in it. it definitely felt like I had put Vicks on my face. Once I rinsed it off though it got much worse. Not sure if this is supposed to make your face feel clean or what but it is completely unnecessary and very uncomfortable. The one from the ordinary is much better with cleaner ingredients. Will be returning

definitely does what it's supposed to, leaves my skin smooth and does a great job of getting rid of those dark spots!!

My texture is way more smooth and my dark spots are barely noticeable. I feel way more confident now to wear my skin out with no makeup at all.

This gave me such a glow from within! First time I used it it did tingle a bit but afterwards my skin got used to it. Any texture I had beforehand was smoothed out and it gave a beautiful glow. Just make sure to wear sunscreen afterwards!
This product cleared up my hyperpigmentation pretty quickly. You get many uses after 1 bottle. Gentle and a great introduction into exfoliant peels if you're new to them!

First of all, the packaging is exceptional, eye-catching, and aesthetically pleasing, with an appealing color scheme. Every time I used it, my skin felt fresh and smooth, with visibly tighter pores. Plus, the product has a light, pleasant scent.

I loved using this! A little goes a long way, it really exfoliates and brightens the complexion while remaining gentle. It was easy to wash off & am impressed with how well it's formulated. I love the fun glittery mint color too
I enjoyed this product. It's easy to apply and has a fresh cooling feeling to it. I noticed after washing it off, my face instantly looked brighter!
I've been using L'Oreal Bright Reveal Dark Spot Exfoliant Peel for a month, and the results are impressive. My face ffells smoother I highly recommend.i would keeping using it

I love it, super soft, leaves the skin soft and renewed. It's like a green mask with glitter, I like it so it's easier to rinse off and doesn't leave residue on the skin. Homemade peeling effect, called snake peel, renews the skin after lightening and acts quickly against spots. Highly recommended

My First impressions was it is a very pretty color, teal with shimmer. Nice texture. went on very nice on the skin, didn't make my skin feel weird. A little tingling around corners of lips. Wasn't harsh removing it. Applied moisturizer as normal

avis.titre: Great Peel for a Low Cost
avis.texte: I have been using this peel twice weekly for about a month. I have tan-deep brown skin and have to be careful about what acids I use to prevent PIH. Thank you to L'oreal for sending me this peel to review on my dark skin! I not only use this on my face, but on my knees and elbows. The difference between my knees before and after this peel is insane: they have to be at least 4 shades lighter, and they are so much softer than before! Unexpected win. Here's what I love: - There is a slight blue shimmer to this product. This is a fantastic indicator as to whether the peel has been entirely removed from the skin after a rinse. - The applicator ensures that no product can be accidentally spilled. This is also a fantastic way to avoid product spoiling from exposure to air. The dispensing technique allows less air to reach the body of the product, which is *always* a pro: exposure to air may weaken or strengthen chemical product formulations, making them lose effectiveness or causing them to become harmful to the skin. - The packaging is vanity-worthy. Aside from working spectacularly, this bottle is actually really cute. It reminds me of The Ordinary in a way. Here's what I'd caution you to do: - Start slowly. I would try the peel for about 5 minutes on your first go, removing it if you experience any burning. I felt a really pleasant tingle/coolness upon application. Burning, on the other hand, is a sign that your skin is damaged, and not ready to use any peel! - Apply a barrier to

I received this product for free for review. This exfoliator is less tingly and unpleasant than other chemical exfoliants I've used in the past. It is quite doable. This item performed admirably. When I used it consistently, it significantly brightened up my skin and eliminated dark circles. There's no unpleasant smell about it. After using, I didn't feel dry at all. The dry areas on my skin vanished. Please apply sunscreen, as others have suggested.

avis.titre: Already started to notice a difference in my skin
avis.texte: I've been using the product for about three weeks now and my skin feels softer and looks to be more cleared up! I still have bumps on my forehead, which I've already had but there's a noticeable change to my skin after using the product! Love the packaging too, makes it so easy to get product out!

I've been using this 3-4 times a week for 3 weeks now. I have never had this much improvement in that little amount of time. Each seeker my spots become less and less visible. I like this product and will recommend my friends to try it.
I used this product after my shower, I waited 15 minutes to rinse it off. And it was amazing, my face has never been so clear!!

I'll first start off by saying I received this product free of charge in exchange for my honest review. Over a 21+ day usage, I have not noticed the first change in discoloration in the dark spot areas I utilized the product on. Neither did I ever notice the skin "peel" to expose new skin. The product does have a light scent and it smells good. The bottle wasn't made too well; glass bottle with a flimsy rubber tip. This allowed for too much product to be expelled from the bottle all at once.

avis.titre: It was a good product and will most likely be a good buy.
avis.texte: The packaging of this product is exceptional—truly eye-catching and aesthetically pleasing. The color scheme is also very appealing. Upon the first application, I experienced a tingling sensation that gradually subsided. Almost immediately, I noticed a radiant glow on my skin. Considering I have sensitive skin, this reaction was quite impressive.

After rinsing my face though, after about the first week my skin was softer. BUT my cheeks got so dry! It didn't matter what moisturizer I used my cheeks were irritated. Even when I cut down and used it 1x a week.

This exfoliator is magic. There's literally no other way I could describe it. It's so gentle but I see immediate results after 1 use. I used product as indicated on instructions! It has become my mid week product for pampering at home. I rarely get acne but when I do I get post dark spot from acne and this product has been amazing!

Thank you BzzAgent and L'Oreal for sending this amazing product for me to try! My acne scars are significantly down and my skin is SO SMOOTH. I LOVE this product and have added it to my routine. I definitely will continue to use this product.

avis.titre: A Spa Treatment That Makes Me Feel Like Moonlight
avis.texte: It smells divine, and makes me feel serene and like I am in a spa. The color of the product is so fun, and when you apply it, it gives you an iridiscent glow that makes you look like you have been bathed in bright, starry, moonlight. I like that it is light to the touch but packs a punch, and I'm excited that it will continue to reveal my inner glow and brighten my skin!

I really have taken my time trying out this product and this is my honest review. I have used it for over 4 weeks 2 times per week. At first the tingling was too much to leave it the full time stated so I would wash off after 10 minutes. As I kept trying it I increased the time and the tingle was more bearable. After my 4th time using it, I was able to use it the entire time. Every time I used it my skin had a very fresh feeling like if you had wiped Vicks all over your face. I kept trying it because it also made my skin so smooth and my pores looked tighter. After 2 weeks I did notice my skin much brighter and by the 4th week a few of my dark spots looked much lighter. I will continue to use it, may be I will use it more frequently to see if I get faster results.
This product have very specific instructions and can cause irritation if you mix contradictions. Might be a good product if you're consistent. I didn't see too much of a difference.

I have been using this at least two to three times a week. What I have noticed is consistency is key if you want results. It will work. Just have to take your time with it. I prefer to use this as a spot treatment. I am dark complected and I do feel it has lighten the areas to give an overall even tone. It's nice to have a product you can pick up pretty much anywhere and it works great.

I've been using this for a few weeks now and I definitely notice a difference! I have hyperpigmentation from acne and being out in the sun makes the spots get bigger. After using this, I feel like it's not only helped to fade the hyperpigmentation but also prevented any other sun spots from forming. Not sure if it's from the product directly, but I feel like it's actually helped prevent acne too! The only thing I wish I could change about this product is not having to wash the product off my face after 15 minutes. Sometimes I either forgot to wash it off or didn't feel like applying the product because I didn't want to wait.

This product exceeded my expectations, I will be honest and say I didn't have the highest of hopes for this product when Initially saw it. Initially I wasn't a fan of the packaging and bottle the color is a little off putting aswell and when I tested actual product it had a glittery affect which isn't bad but I tend to like skincare products that don't have any extra additives but anyhow once I applied the product to my face it was very easy to use and had a nice smell it smelt very fruity which is nice instead of chemical smell, I have a few dark spots that I would like to clear up I made sure to apply it to those areas and once I washed it off it I was super surprised after about two days I noticed peeling and and the dark spot lightening.. I will be definitely using this product more in the future, it works wonders!!

**How I used the product:** I've been using the L'Oréal Paris Bright Reveal Dark Spot Exfoliant Peel every other night, right before bed. After washing my face, I slap on a thin layer of the peel. I let it work its magic overnight and wash it off with warm water in the morning, followed by my go-to moisturizer and, of course, sunscreen. **Things that are great about it:** This stuff really works! My dark spots started to fade, and my skin felt smoother after just a month. The glycolic acid gently exfoliates without irritating my skin, and I love how easy and hygienic the packaging is. **Things that aren't great about it:** The peel does tingle a bit when you put it on, which might be a bit much for sensitive skin. You also have to be super diligent about using sunscreen during the day because it makes your skin more sensitive to the sun. And, you need a bit of patience—the results take a few weeks to show up.

This product is great I am currently pregnant and due to it I got all this black spots on my face and neck, but since I started exfoliating with this product the dark spots vanished so I live and really recommend it.

I used this on my skin for 3 weeks and definitely noticed brighter skin! I prefer this one over the Ordinary. It wasn't too harsh and there isn't a ton of flaking skin if used as directed (i.e. do not use it daily). The packaging is sturdy and I feel keeps the product sanitary. Also, there no bothersome smell. I'll be using this again.

Using it for almost 3 weeks but I am using it twice a week. And it's working good. I am using it with Tretinoin so skin shading is there but I can see the result so happy with it. Will continue using it. Recommended to acne prone and pores skin.

I feel like I could only ever get a few drops out, not enough to actually cover my face (that also might be why I never saw much of an effect on my hyperpigmentation).

After three weeks of use my spots have visibly faded in my skin looks brighter and revived.

I stopped using all skin products that I normally use for two weeks in order to start with a clean slate and so that I wasn't mixing things that didn't go together. This exfoliant peel made my skin extremely dry no matter how much I moisturized my face.
Applied product on dry face, used within guide of instructions and I loved the results it has given my skin a healthy hydration.

I tried this product for a month and definitely saw a reduction to some of my dark spots. Easy to apply as well. I just felt it was burn and have little bit itchy when I applied. However, I will continue to use to see more visible results for dark spots.

I was so grateful to have received this product in exchange for my review!
This was a great and simple product to use! Good drugstore exfoliant to use

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!

I can't really see much results in terms of skin lightening but I have decreased break outs since using it. Make sure to not overdo it or you might end up with dry sensitive skin. Don't forget the sunscreen!
This is nice for someone looking to start their skin care routine at home and is very beginner friendly.

avis.auteur: This product worked great. It fades dark

As someone with dry skin I have to reapply moisturizer occasionally throughout the day but this had improved my dryness. The only thing I didn't like about this product was the sparkle stuff in it. You probably wouldn't even notice the glitter but once I did I couldn't ignore it.

This product definitely clears dark spots over time, but you have to use it consistently to achieve the desired results. It is not a miracle worker, but consistency will be your friend with this! The color and texture are interesting, and was going viral on social media! Overall, would recommend.
A tad bit harsh on my sensitive skin but still used because I wanted to see if it would work and I believe I do see a difference on my hyperpigmentation.

Thank you L'Oréal for sending me the bright reveal dark spot exfoliant peel through BzzAgent! I love all my L'Oréal products so I know this will become a staple in my skin care routine!

I would absolutely recommend this product to anyone, especially those with a little bit of texture or sebaceous filaments like me. I was a bit skeptical going in but I swear I noticed a significant difference in even just the first application! After continued use according to instructions the texture has almost completely resolved. Do yourself a favor and purchase this product!

I started using this product and noticed a little of dryness starting up so make sure to moisturize!! I did notice a bunch of my dark spot and acne scars start to fade. I haven't stop receiving compliments on how my skin looks so glowly !

I saw a difference in my dark spots after a few days of using, my darkspots were not extremely pigmented but i definitely saw a difference. It really dried out my skin though so I suggest using a very thick moisturizer and sunscreen when using the product

I've been using this a few times a week and can already see a big difference in my skin tone! It's basically made certain spots almost disappear!

I noticed immediate results after one use. I have tried similar products from more expensive brands and this worked just as well! I am in my thirties with old acne scars and dry sensitive skin. I really loved how easy it is to use and never once irritated my skin. Highly recommend if you want to help brighten some dark spots/acne scars. Make sure you use only at night and a good spf in the day.

I've used this got about two weeks and it has been good so far. I have a lot of dark spots and they seem to be a bit faded. I will be using it longer to see if it notice a more significant change. It felt relatively gentle compared to other peels and didn't irritate my skin. It's a good budget friendly option.

avis.titre: Theres no other product like this at the drugstore!
avis.texte: I noticed just after one use that my skin was extremely smooth and my pores were smaller. My face just felt re-textured. After 4 uses, I could tell overall that my skin was still smooth and more radiant. After the 2nd use, a little bit of the top layer on an old pimple kind of flaked off leaving a much lighter blemish! If you are new to chemical pills and chemical exfoliating products that have acids (AHA, BHA, or PHAs), I would proceed with caution and maybe use it once or 2x a week. There is a noticeable stinging sensation when you apply the peel. I love that L'Oreal added a shimmer to the product so that you can see where you've applied it. Its a great feature to make sure no product is left when you rinse off the peel. Overall, this is a really nice product. There's nothing like it at the drugstore price point. So because of that, I definitely recommend it. However, if you have sensitive skin or if you aren't used to chemical exfoliating products, be very careful and work in a very light layer maybe once a week.

avis.titre: Necessary part of my skin care routine
avis.texte: I loved this product. Even after one use, my skin was noticeably smoother and my dark spots were less prevalent. I would definitely continue to buy. It is very easy to use and a good product to incorporate into my skin care routine!

The L'Oréal Bright Reveal Dark Spot Exfoliant Peel effectively reduces dark spots and brightens the complexion with its glycolic acid and vitamin C formula. Easy to use with a precise applicator, it delivers noticeable improvements in skin texture and tone within weeks. Suitable for most skin types, it offers great value for money with its dermatologist-tested, gentle formula.

avis.titre: I would buy  this product in the future!!
avis.texte: First time user for this exfoliant peel and to be honest it's pretty good, it never gives me burn feeling or itchy works great for me. Reduces my dark spots on my nose. I love this product would love to have this in my routine.

"Wow, I am absolutely amazed by the results of this dark spot exfoliating peel! I've struggled with stubborn dark spots on my skin for years, and nothing seemed to work. But after using this peel for just a few weeks, I noticed a significant improvement in the appearance of my dark spots. They have lightened up so much, and my skin looks much more even-toned and radiant. The peel itself is easy to use and gentle on the skin. I love that it doesn't cause any irritation or redness, unlike some other peels I've tried in the past. The formula is also packed with powerful ingredients that target dark spots and exfoliate the skin, leaving it feeling smooth and rejuvenated. I've incorporated this peel into my skincare routine, using it twice a week, and the results have been outstanding. Not only have my dark spots faded, but my overall skin texture has improved as well. It feels softer, smoother, and looks more youthful. I highly recommend this dark spot exfoliating peel to anyone struggling with hyperpigmentation or uneven skin tone. It's a game-changer! Say goodbye to dark spots and hello to a brighter, more radiant complexion. You won't be disappointed!"

I really like this product. It dries fast and doesn't leave a residue. I noticed brightening around some of my hyperpigmentation. The only thing I don't like is the smell. A lot of L'Oréal face products have a smell and I like my facial products fragrance free.
The product did brighten my dark spots, however it didn't help my acne. I could be wrong may have to let it work it's magic a little longer. All in all I will try again.

avis.titre: Does work but have to be mindful of what you use it with
avis.texte: I have sensitive combination skin and suffer from dark spots. It does say to use it 4 times a week but not back to back. Due to my sensitive skin, I could only use once a week. I do see difference in the initial lighter spots that actually looks more faded at the end of month. But the very dark spots have very slight and not so noticeable difference. A month doesn't show big difference overall but if I continue, I will see more of a difference difference in 3 months compared to day one. Heed the warning to be careful what you use in combination with this as not to get a chemical burn. On days I use this, I just kept with basic moisturizer at night. I am giving it a 3 rating as average as I did not see drastic change in the month but I know it is working even if slowly.

I have a couple dark spots on the side of my cheeks from pimples and acnes. I used the product once every 5-7 days (im not always consistent) but i can still see results after 2-3 uses. The dark spots are lighter and smoother in textures.

This product confused me a bit when I first got it. I did read the instructions on the box, but I think it should have had more detail and also some directions on the bottle itself. The first time I used it, I was really surprised by the stinging, so I washed it off within a couple minutes. I had to look up if the sensation was normal. I also struggled a bit the first time I tried to squeeze out the product, since it was not very intuitive and I had forgotten what the box said. You need to squeeze where my pinkie is in the photo. The product itself works nicely, and I like how shimmery it is. It's fun to use. I think it does a great job with evening my complexion.

I had the opportunity to try this product for a few weeks. I found that it helped some of my dark spots lighten up a bit. They are not quite gone but I have definitely noticed an improvement. I did feel some irritation on application but it quickly went away. I think it has helped even out my complexion and I would recommend it, but would be wary of trying if I have sensitive skin.

I was scared to use this at first as I didn't want my face to fall off, but it certainly did not. It's a very mild exfoliant, not one that will make you look like you came back from vacation with a bad sunburn. After you wash it off there is a minty feeling on your skin, which is very refreshing. And after it makes your skin feel so soft. The scent is very mild nothing too perfumey, which is a plus for me. Overall I really like this, it's great for beginners, very idiot proof.

This product is great for someone who has hyperpigmentation or acne scars who wants them gone! I always gotten compliments on my skin but always hated how I have post acne scars on my cheeks that stand out to me. When I first tried this product it did sting a bit at first, then my skin adjusted to it. Although I don't have sensitive skin, I wouldn't recommend this to someone with sensitive skin, as this would most likely irritate their skin. I started seeing results after 2 weeks! My skin looked more radiant, and clearer. My acne marks are slowly fading away. The product itself comes in a bottle with a syringe like pump that you have to squeeze to get the product out. I like how it won't easily spill if it fell over and looks different from other skincare products. With this product you're suppose to leave it on for 15 minutes and rinse off, then apply moisturizer. It doesn't have any fragrance which is great, it feels smooth and not heavy or sticky. I would recommend then to someone who doesn't have sensitive skin, and wants to clear up any dark spots on their face

avis.titre: Good product.. wouldn't buy it though
avis.texte: I feel that this product would be much better suited to being a mask instead that hardens on the face. Also, most people don't do peels at home. It's too scary to do a treatment that should be applied by someone with an actual license at home.

I was SO excited to receive this product because it said it'd help even out my skin tone. However, I did not notice any difference in my skin tone hence the rating. I gave this 3 stars because it was gentle on my skin (zero irritation, zero redness, zero tingling). I have normal skin. Other than that, it really didn't do much for my skin.
A little goes a long way with immediate results. Skin feels smoother and tighter after one use. Will continue to use to see more visible results for dark spots. Easy to apply as well.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy the product again
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for a review. I tried this product for a month and definitely saw a reduction to some of my dark spots. There was some drying but that is expected for a product of this type. I am willing to buy this product in the future to continue to see improvements in my overall skin texture and coloration.
Easy to use to reveal your best skin ever 🤩 this product has helped clear my skin and make it look for useful and brighter! I've been using twice a week since I can have sensitive skin.

If you have lots of acne scars, bumps, or blemishes, thsi is for you. I guess I didn't have as much as I thought I did, because it was very powerful. Remember to WEAR SUNSCREEN while using this, you will need it!

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this product non stop since I received it. I struggle with acne and acne scarring and I noticed a significant improvment after using this as recommended. It smells great, has a cool tingly sensation, and washes off easily. My skin looks more smooth, refreshed, bright, and my scarring looks noticeably less. I highly recommend and will continue to use this product!

I've been using this for a couple of weeks now and I've seen a difference in the darkened spots on my skin. It's made my skin feel smoother and reduced the appearance of spots as well. I can't wait to continue using it to see what other results come my way!

This exfoliant peel is great. It really exfoliates through all the crevices in your face, plus it feels so refreshing once you wash it off. It's cooling and leaves my skin feeling so soft. I just add some moisturizer afterwards and my face stays soft and calm all day.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again!
avis.texte: Not only did it make my dark spots go away but it also made the circles under my eyes disappear as well!
I've been using this product for 3 weeks & I am pleased! I do see a few dark spot lightening. I will leave another review with 3 more weeks.
L'Oreal skincare has never let me down, and this is no exception. I've been using this alone with just moisturizer and sunscreen, and my skin spots have been fading so nicely. I'm glad I found this!

I started using the L'Oreal Paris Bright Reveal Exfoliant Peel and am very surprised at how well it works at exfoliating my face while still being gentle enough to not irritate my skin. After a few uses I already noticed a difference in texture on my face. Definitely gonna keep using

I was intimidated at first because of it being a peel. I had to read the instructions like 3x before feeling comfortable, but since using the peel I feel like I could absolutely do it again. I will use it again. I think this product could actually make a difference in my skin and it feels nice to light some candles and take time for myself.
